purpose: Bind an explicitly selected representation to a deterministic derivation of the existing four-lane backend registry.
base: Exact separately identified psc-backend-registry/1 with four lanes and the existing closed JS input/lowerer/validator/writer.
derivation: Change only the JavaScript lane input to uniform-specialized-ir/psc-uniform-specialized-ir/1, lower pass to psc-uniform-ir-to-js-ir/1 and selected staged API. Preserve other lanes and the shared JsIR validator/runtime/writer. Capability and product lists state available uniform generic declarations and omit unsupported closed-instance maps and source-map composition.
consumers: scripts/observed-build-context.mjs: explicit host selection before descriptor/action/query/bundle creation
scripts/backend-contract.mjs: bounded fresh derivation during bundle verification
scripts/observed-build-archive.mjs: exact uniform selection and target inventory replay
binding: Bundle evidence contains exactly one selection when its descriptor consumes uniform-specialized-ir.
The target profile binds the selection identity; every observed action and query binds that target profile.
Context verification requires a connected verified-to-uniform-to-JsIR-to-JS pipeline and rejects simultaneous closed-specialized artifacts.
Archive replay compares uniform payload bytes with exact VerifiedIR, validates complete JsIR declaration/parameter inventory and regenerates selected source declarations.
compatibility: Existing registry, descriptor, bundle and graph schema versions stay exact. Historical closed records need no selection record. No automatic profile inference or fallback; no fifth backend. Current producers use selection/2. The version-1 derivation is frozen, including its historical driver-entry emitterId; replay never silently upgrades those bytes or claims correct backend-emitter ownership for them.
remaining: Portable declaration serializer and production checked CLI profile selection
Independent target representation and global preservation assurance
